name: scope-earlier-valid
code: transformed data { real earlier = 1; real later = earlier; } model {}

name: scope-parameters-gq-valid
code: parameters { real shared; } model { target += shared; } generated quantities { real y = shared; }

name: comma-order-valid
code: model { real first = 1, second = first, third = second; target += third; }

name: function-inner-scope-valid
code: functions { real f(real x) { { real inner = x; return inner; } } } model { target += f(1); }

name: known-hof-value-valid
code: functions { real partial_sum(array[] real slice, int start, int end) { return sum(slice); } } data { int N; array[N] real x; } model { target += reduce_sum(partial_sum, x, 1); }

name: prototype-definition-valid
code: functions { real declared(real x); real uses(real x) { return declared(x); } real declared(real x) { return x; } } model { target += uses(1); }
